tutorial.finish: Finish and set up a match

steps.step1: Find your starting cash above. This practice match is separate from normal matches.
steps.step2: Roll the real dice to move. The fixed practice seed guarantees an available property.
steps.step3: Read the landing space, price and rent in the current action. Continue when you have inspected them.
steps.step4: Choose Buy or Skip. Buying spends cash and earns rent when the opponent lands here.
steps.step5: Watch the computer finish its real turn. Then return to setup for a fresh match; practice assets do not carry over.

goal.title: Winning and rounds
goal.body: Play 2–4 seats with at least one local human and optional normal computers. Multiple humans confirm Pass the device before playing; restoration requires confirmation again. The seed fixes turn order once; Pause shows it. Eliminated seats are skipped without moving the round boundary. Quick matches last {quick} full rounds; standard matches last {standard}. The final seat must finish its decision before the round counts. Rank by cash plus property book value, then cash; equal results tie. Only the last solvent player wins early. If eliminated, watch or leave from Pause.

turn.title: Your turn
turn.body: Roll two dice, move by their total and resolve the landing. Buy an available property or skip it. The fixed order selects the next player; computers act automatically. Doubles do not grant another turn.

property.title: Property and rent
property.body: Buying costs the displayed price. Landing on an opponent’s property pays its displayed rent. Your own property costs nothing. There are no buildings, mortgages, auctions, trades or held items yet.

money.title: Money and events
money.body: Initial cash is ¥{cash}; passing Start earns ¥{bonus}. Tax spaces charge their displayed fee. Chance gives an immediate random gain or expense. Cash below zero currently means bankruptcy: properties return to the bank and stop collecting rent; historical purchase costs remain. There is no debt-rescue phase yet.

view.title: View and controls
view.body: Board overview shows the whole board and all pawns. Return to your first-person view for optional mouse look; mouse lock is never automatic. Touch starts in overview. Roll, buy and skip also have screen buttons.

keys.title: Keyboard
keys.body: Space rolls, B buys, N skips and M toggles sound when available. Shortcuts do not activate inside forms or help. Esc first exits mouse lock or the current panel; otherwise it opens Pause. There is no WASD free movement.

navigation.title: Pause, settings and results
navigation.body: Settings changes language, sound and mouse sensitivity. Pause and backgrounding settle animation at the committed destination without repeating payments; returning to the foreground requires explicit Resume. Practice does not replace your saved match. Results explain the winner and financial details; original-seed replay is optional.

saving.title: Local saves and recovery
saving.body: Actions save before presentation. Main Menu preserves the save; Play Again replaces it. Saving failures offer retry, export or explicit unsaved play. A change from another page pauses this page instead of overwriting it. Import and backup recovery require validation, preview and confirmation. Damaged raw data can be exported and is not automatically erased. Files contain names and the full state: keep them private. Browsers may clear local data.

transfer.title: Import and recover saves
transfer.limit: Choose a .richman.json file of at most 1 MiB. Reading and validation do not replace your match.
transfer.replace: Confirmation replaces the current save and this page’s unsaved progress. Export any data you need first. A valid current snapshot becomes the backup; damaged data is replaced only with your confirmation. Continue from the menu afterwards.
transfer.imported: This will be an imported match, not a formal challenge score. The source label is not an anti-cheat guarantee.

errors.unavailable: The file or local storage could not be accessed. Your current match is preserved; retry when access is available.
errors.invalid: The data is invalid or cannot be exported unchanged. Your current match is preserved; choose a valid file or backup.
errors.incompatible: This file uses an unsupported format, map or rules version. Keep the original file; it has not replaced your match.
errors.conflict: Another page changed the save. Nothing was replaced. Read a fresh preview before confirming again.
errors.too_large: The file exceeds 1 MiB and was not read. Choose a smaller match file.
errors.backupUnavailable: No valid, supported backup is available. Current data is preserved; export it or choose a valid file.

storage.exportWarning: The file includes player names and the full match state. Keep it private unless you intend to share it.
storage.unsaved: This match has unsaved progress. The previous saved data is preserved.
storage.conflict: Another page changed the saved match. This page is paused and cannot overwrite it.
storage.discardWarning: Discarding loses only this page’s unsaved progress; it does not erase the saved match.
storage.preserved: The committed match is saved locally. Main Menu preserves it; playing again replaces it.
storage.replaceWarning: Starting this match replaces the current saved match. The previous valid snapshot is kept as a backup.
storage.unavailable: Local match storage is unavailable. You may start a match and choose to play without saving.
storage.invalid: The saved data is damaged or uses an unsupported version. It has not been erased.

runtime.title: Richman 3D
